card.name: Linking words in website notices and disclaimers
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and", "or", "see" or "only" inside website notices, disclaimers and course descriptions, mostly just before the next item in a list or a closing phrase.

modes.label: Joining list items
modes.description: The word "and" or "or" links two items in a list of sources, features or options.

modes.label: Closing or pointing words
modes.description: A word like "see" or "only" ends a short instruction or limit in web notices.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens, which are scattered; the pole suppresses words like "useless", "worthless" and "without".
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in everyday website notices and disclaimers, where a list or a phrase is about to continue.
